top9_definition: Expected display text occurs at rank 1 through 9 inclusive in actual engine.lookup candidates.

initial_pass.diagnostic: Initial engine placed some complete long-word candidates in slot nine, then removed them while reserving a shorter-prefix candidate. Parent reproduced and repaired this general engine behavior using independent synthetic tests; frozen dictionary keys and weights were retained.
